_doc: INTERNAL — Pirate Wires editorial register mapped to NFRI thesis Acts I–IV. Never render Pirate Wires URLs, author names, or publication branding on site. Consumed by voice_guide.json, thesis_presentation.json, *_writing.json contracts, deploy agents. Complements contract/sequoia_thesis_style.json (market-essay arc) and American Dynamism / ARC reindustrialisation frames.

sources.pattern: tech × politics × culture — three domains where capacity, incentives, and narrative collide
inside X — reporter in scene before abstract thesis; first-person stakes when earned
title states claim; lowercase deck asks the question the piece will answer
contested framing laundered into settled fact — name the laundering, then show the evidence gap
are we really going to reindustrialize? — builder optimism with civilizational urgency, not brochure optimism
regulation paralysis + meddlesome process vs builders who need to ship — structural, not moral
brief daily takes — one load-bearing sentence per beat; no hedge-word soup

editorial_backbone.shared_thread: Physical-world builders are carrying bets the abstract layer cannot see — reindustrialisation runs on mispriced risk, not vibes.
editorial_backbone.tone: Optimistic urgency: the experiment can still work, but only if someone measures what the damage stack ignores.

macro_beats.deliver: Open in a concrete locus — curtailment notice, SLA clock, connection queue screen — before the thesis sentence.
Headline states the claim; deck asks the hinge question (are we really pricing availability? does damage BI still fit?).
Name what reindustrialisation requires — firm electrons, honest registers — and what breaks if the cover stays on damage.
Show where the market treats availability as settled under damage wordings — contested loss type laundered into renewal routine.
Grid reform and connections gate as capacity story — process vs throughput; incentives before blame.
Inside the placement stack / register layer — who moves, on what form, with what trigger gap.
Italic pull between beats: one sentence, no hedging — the hinge the next section proves.
Whitespace is where cover should start — name carriers and registers, not another dashboard.
Close on who carries unrated availability if reindustrialisation proceeds on non-firm connections — turn, not summary.

nfri_translations.tech_politics_culture: Grid capacity × market structure × builder economics — three lenses on the same interruptible-connection bet.
nfri_translations.inside_micron_parallel: Inside the connections queue: reform on the wire, non-firm clearance fastest, damage BI still the renewal default.
nfri_translations.are_we_really: Are we really reindustrialising on interruptible grid access without pricing lawful curtailment?
nfri_translations.laundered_discourse: Damage BI treated as settled cover for compute and generation load — availability loss laundered into 'wait for the adjuster'.
nfri_translations.state_capacity_grid: Gate 1/2 and register reform vs placement inertia — capacity paralysed by forms that predate flexible connections.
nfri_translations.war_on_innovation_parallel: Bipartisan neglect of register-native pricing — public data exists, premium functions ignore it.
nfri_translations.vibes_off: Rising constraint costs meet flat damage premiums — the market feels covered while exposure outruns preparedness.
nfri_translations.experiment_at_risk: Reindustrialisation is an experiment in speed vs firmness; the insurance stack still prices the wrong peril.
nfri_translations.field_report_open: A curtailment notice lands. No crater. No adjuster. The SLA clock starts anyway.
nfri_translations.fire_take_deck: following queue reform and an army of damage schedules, we mapped who carries interruptible access — are we really going to underwrite it?

headline_patterns.title: Declarative or provocative question — 6–12 words, argues.
headline_patterns.deck: Lowercase conversational clause ending in ? when the section is investigative; states stakes when declarative.
headline_patterns.kicker: Two to four words, uppercase — THE COLLISION, THE QUEUE, WHITE SPACE equivalent: THE WEDGE, THE GAP.
headline_patterns.section_pull: One fire-take sentence between major beats — italic blockquote, no hedge.

prose_rules: Open with scene or deck question before machinery — never throat-clearing.
Name discourse laundering when damage framing stands in for availability loss.
Civilizational stakes once per act — reindustrialisation requires honest cover, not a vibes check.
Field-report first person only when the writer is in the locus (queue, register, placement) — not decorative.
Fire-take pulls: one sentence, load-bearing, between beats.
Optimistic urgency: builders can win if measurement precedes bind — not doom, not brochure.
No Pirate Wires author names, publication branding, or URLs on rendered site.
Pair every PW energy move with cite or PROVISIONAL — punch without invented numbers.
avoid: Slang or culture-war diction on rendered site — energy yes, edgelord no.
US-partisan framing — NFRI is UK grid and London market structure.
Naked fire takes without evidence tier or cite.
Civilizational rhetoric without a physical-world anchor (queue GW, register field, named form).
Summary closes — always turn on who carries unrated availability.
